requirements.title: NOT complements every bit in bit context
requirements.definition: The NOT result is obtained by complementing I bit-by-bit, with input bit 1 mapped to 0 and input bit 0 mapped to 1.

pending.NOT-zero-bits-become-one: Use BOZ actual B'0' and integer zero; assert POPCNT(NOT(0)) equals BIT_SIZE(0) and BTEST(NOT(B'0'),0) is true, observing only bit context; mutate NOT to identity so the count and bit test fail.
pending.NOT-one-bits-become-zero: Use BOZ actual B'1'; assert BTEST(NOT(B'1'),0) is false while BTEST(NOT(B'0'),0) is true, and mutate the BOZ actual or intrinsic so the paired bit tests discriminate.
pending.NOT-complement-round-trip: Construct an operand with leftmost bits set by A=NOT(0), then assert POPCNT(NOT(A)) equals zero and NOT(NOT(B'1010')) has the original selected low-bit pattern by BTEST; mutate either NOT call to IOR so round-trip checks fail.
